name: T3 cross-tool join
title: Meeting transcript to CRM: action items become Salesforce tasks
description: Anthropic's code-execution-with-MCP example made concrete: fetch a 125 KB meeting doc from a document store, extract the action items, resolve each against Salesforce (exact account name, active user, open opportunity), create tasks, update next steps, and attach the full transcript to a Salesforce record. The transcript flows tool to tool and never returns to the model. Synthetic data, Drive and Salesforce REST shapes.

searchFiles.description: Search Google Drive files by name (files.list with name contains each word), newest first.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the file name (case-insensitive).

pageSize.description: Maximum number of files to return. Default: 100

searchFiles.outputDescription: {kind, incompleteSearch, files: [{id, name, mimeType, modifiedTime, owners: [{displayName, emailAddress}], size}]}

getDocument.description: Get a Google Docs document exported as plain text.
getDocument.outputDescription: {id, name, mimeType, modifiedTime, content} where content is the full document text.

query.description: Run a SOQL query (GET /services/data/v62.0/query?q=...). String literals use single quotes; escape a quote inside a literal as \'.

q.description: The SOQL query, e.g. SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Acme'

query.outputDescription: {totalSize, done, records: [{attributes: {type, url}, Id, ...selected fields}]}. Objects: Account (Id, Name, Industry, Type, BillingCountry, AnnualRevenue, NumberOfEmployees, OwnerId), User (Id, Name, Email, IsActive, Title, Department), Opportunity (Id, Name, AccountId, StageName, IsClosed, IsWon, Amount, CloseDate, Probability, NextStep, OwnerId).

fields.description: Fields to return. Default: all fields.

createRecord.description: Create a record (POST /services/data/v62.0/sobjects/{sobject}). Supported: Task, Event, Meeting_Note__c (Name, Meeting_Date__c, Transcript__c long text up to 131072 characters).

record.description: Field values of the new record.

createRecord.outputDescription: {id, success, errors} on success. Failures reject with a Salesforce error list [{message, errorCode}].

source.data: synthetic, seeded (fixture.ts, seed 20261029); mock Drive and Salesforce in mock.ts; generate.ts records the programs' calls
source.programs: model-written by Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) from prompt + api.d.ts; variants from a second model to be added
